recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future wording or metadata changes for condition-reviewed should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than restoring the extension definition to core.
issue_request: FHIR-31417 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. Patient Care decided to add a reviewed 0..1 dateTime extension for Condition, with wording that a populated reviewed date means a clinician indicates the data was reviewed but does not imply validation because clinician interpretation may vary.
initial_application: The change was initially applied in core by fae49f4994, which added source/condition/structuredefinition-extension-condition-reviewed.xml and referenced StructureDefinition/condition-reviewed from source/condition/implementationguide-Condition-core.xml.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f17 later removed the Condition extension definitions during the R5 extension migration. Current source/history.html says all extensions moved to hl7.fhir.uv.extensions while still being published as part of the specification, and current source/oids.ini retains the condition-reviewed OID. The current FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains input/definitions/Condition/StructureDefinition-condition-reviewed.xml with Condition context, max 1 extension cardinality, dateTime value, and the Jira caveat comment.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was made because the authoritative source for this extension is now the FHIR Extension Pack and that source already satisfies the Jira decision.

related_jiras.note: Gravity IG issue that raised the same validated-date concern and pointed back to FHIR-31417; it belongs to FHIR-us-sdoh-cc and was not a core-source decision here.
